extracted_factors.Label: Increased Land Surface Temperature (LST)
extracted_factors.Description: A result of coal mining activities, leading to higher surface temperatures in adjacent forested areas.

extracted_factors.Label: Change in Vegetation (NDVI)
extracted_factors.Description: Changes in Normalized Difference Vegetation Index indicate alteration in vegetation health and density around mining areas.

extracted_factors.Label: Soil Degradation
extracted_factors.Description: Mining leads to degradation of soil properties, affecting microbial communities and nutrient levels.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation
extracted_factors.Description: An outcome of coal mining activities, leading to the loss of forested areas and disruption of ecosystems.

extracted_factors.Label: Groundwater Pollution
extracted_factors.Description: Coal mining activities pollute groundwater, affecting surrounding ecosystems.
